annotations.text: Updated renders — the warm cream / dark-sidebar system from the earlier Review & Approval canvas, icons throughout, hover lift on every card. Nav is now 5 items (Overview, Upload, Review, Names, Models) — Settings moved under Models as its second tab rather than sitting in the sidebar on its own, so every screen's Settings link is gone in favour of that tab bar.

Two granularities, now with real product names and URLs instead of internal component labels (Family Card / Frame Card are still the underlying design pattern, just not user-facing anymore). Row 1, under Names: INDIVIDUAL-IMAGE-SET (/names/{individual_id}) — every photo of one confirmed animal — click a photo to reach IMAGE (/names/{individual_id}/{image_id}), one photo fully annotated. Row 2, under Review: the queue at /review lists incoming sightings; selecting one opens TOP MATCH COMPARISON (/review/{image_id}) — target vs Top-N; its rail's Layout toggle and each candidate's pencil route to MATCH LINES (/review/{image_id}/match-lines) and EXTRACTION (/review/{image_id}/extraction/{candidate_id}) respectively. The hierarchy is reflected three ways on every page below: the address pill at top, the nested dark-sidebar links under Review/Names, and the breadcrumb + page-type kicker in the title bar.

Top match comparison: Top 3 is Top N (the rail's coverage note + "show all / search all individuals" bar), a green auto-approve band shows what the ≥0.95 threshold already handled without you, and every candidate's pencil goes straight to Extraction. Match lines and Extraction both carry the same three-level breadcrumb (Review › Top match comparison › ...) and the matching nested sidebar entry, so the URL, the sidebar and the title card always agree on where you are.

The four journeys this app has to support end-to-end, drawn as flowcharts (this canvas runtime has no Mermaid renderer, so these are hand-built diagrams in the same visual language). Colour follows the Review & Approval decision bar: green = confirms/promotes, amber = new/needs-a-look, blue/red = flagged or reverted, dashed grey = a terminal or deferred state.
